title: paeonia mascula
intro: Paeonia mascula, commonly known as the Red Peony, is a perennial plant native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including menstrual disorders, fever, and inflammation. The health benefits of Paeonia mascula include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antiseptic properties, which can help to reduce pain and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Paeonia mascula include glycosides, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
